title: Normal force at C
description: Essential: The final answer for the pressure magnitude at point C is correctly stated as 3mg.

title: Friction coefficient
description: Essential: The final answer for the kinetic friction coefficient μ is correctly stated as 0.2.

title: Initial kinetic energy
description: Essential: The final answer for the required initial kinetic energy at D is correctly stated as 3.5mgR.

title: Energy conservation to C
description: Important: Applies conservation of mechanical energy from B to C to find the speed at C.

title: Centripetal force at C
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law at point C to relate normal force, weight, and centripetal acceleration.

title: Work-energy for friction
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem from B to D to relate gravitational work and friction work.

title: Minimum speed at A
description: Important: Recognizes that just passing the top point A requires the centripetal force to be provided solely by gravity.

title: Work-energy for return trip
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem from D to A, accounting for friction and gravity.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect sign for the work done by friction or gravity in the energy equations.

title: Unit or expression error
description: Pitfall: Provides a final answer with incorrect units or an expression not simplified to the required form (e.g., mgR).
